Our intent is to keep the existing PrusaSlicer code line maintained while the
official repository is read-only and Prusa works on its successor. We are
reviewing the existing upstream backlog, preserving original authorship, and
landing useful changes directly on our `master` branch. This is a community
fork, not an official Prusa merge or endorsement.

We are using local review and targeted tests for fast intake, with fix-forward
or an individual revert if a regression is found. If you know of additional
